intervention: Caloric restriction, rhesus monkey, NIA (121 monkeys, 25-30% CR; controls not ad-lib)

intervention: Dietary restriction in 960 Diversity Outbred female mice (20%, 40% CR, fasting)
result: 40% CR: median +9 months vs ad lib; genetics explained more lifespan variance than diet; greater weight loss linked to shorter life

intervention: Dietary restriction across recombinant inbred mouse strains (Liao 2010)
result: lifespan response ranges from extension to shortening by strain (numbers not verified)

intervention: Human GH-receptor deficiency (Laron; Ecuador & Brazil cohorts)

intervention: Telomerase AAV gene therapy in mice (one lab)
